function base91DecodeToBlobURL(base91String, mime = "application/octet-stream") { let v = -1, b = 0, n = 0; let out = [];
for (let i = 0; i < base91String.length; i++) { let c = BASE91_DECODE[base91String[i]]; if (c === undefined) continue;
if (v < 0) v = c; else { v += c * 91; b |= v << n; n += (v & 8191) > 88 ? 13 : 14;
while (n >= 8) { out.push(b & 255); b >>= 8; n -= 8; } v = -1; } }
if (v >= 0) out.push((b | (v << n)) & 255);
const blob = new Blob([new Uint8Array(out)], { type: mime }); return blob; }
